name: codeany-hubs-mcp-server

tools.name: hubs_list_mine
tools.description:
List hubs owned by the authenticated user.
Example args: {}

tools.name: hubs_detail
tools.description:
Fetch detailed metadata for a single hub.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub"}

tools.name: tasks_create
tasks_list
tools.description:
List tasks within a hub with optional filters.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "page": 1, "filters": {"query": "dp"}}

tools.name: tasks_delete
tools.description:
Delete a task (requires confirmation unless `confirm=true`).
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42}

tools.name: tasks_rename
tools.description:
Rename an existing task.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "name": "new-title", "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_toggle_visibility
tools.description:
Toggle task visibility.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_get_settings
tools.description:
Retrieve task settings (limits, IO, statements metadata).
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42}

tools.name: tasks_type_get
tools.description:
Fetch the current task type metadata (batch/mcq/etc.).
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42}

tools.name: tasks_type_update
tools.description:
Update the task type (batch/mcq/etc.).
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "payload": {"type": "mcq"}, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_mcq_get_config
tools.description:
Retrieve the MCQ configuration for a multiple choice task.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42}

tools.name: tasks_mcq_replace_config
tools.description:
Replace the full MCQ configuration. 'config' object must include 'question' (str), 'options' (list of dicts with 'id', 'text', 'is_correct'), and 'allow_multiple' (bool).
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "config": {"question": "What is 2+2?", "options": [{"id": "A", "text": "4", "is_correct": true}, {"id": "B", "text": "5", "is_correct": false}], "allow_multiple": false}, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_mcq_patch_config
tools.description:
Apply a partial MCQ config patch. 'patch' object contains only fields to update.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "patch": {"question": "Updated Question?"}, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_mcq_set_correct
tools.description:
Mark which MCQ options are correct by ID.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "correct_option_ids": ["A", "C"], "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_limits_get
tools.description:
Retrieve execution limits (time/memory).
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42}

tools.name: tasks_limits_update
tools.description:
Update execution limits (milliseconds / megabytes).
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "time_limit": 2000, "memory_limit": 256, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_statements_get
tools.description:
Retrieve statements for a task (optionally by language). Supported languages include 'en', 'ru', 'az', etc.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "language": "en"}

tools.name: tasks_statements_list
tools.description:
List available statement languages.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42}

tools.name: tasks_statements_create_lang
tools.description:
Create a new statement language payload. Supports 'en', 'ru', 'az', etc. Content fields usually include 'name', 'title', 'legend', 'input_format', 'output_format', 'notes'.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "language": "az", "content": {"title": "Task Title", "name": "Task Name", "legend": "Task description..."}, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_statements_delete_lang
tools.description:
Delete statement content for a locale.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "language": "en", "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_statements_update
tools.description:
Update a specific statement by ID (SDK `update_statement`).
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "statement_id": 7, "payload": {"title": "Updated"}, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_statements_upload_image
tools.description:
Upload an inline statement image. 'image' argument can be base64 data URI, raw bytes, or file path (if local paths allowed).
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "language": "en", "image": "data:image/png;base64,..."}

tools.name: tasks_io_get
tools.description:
Retrieve IO/checker configuration.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42}

tools.name: tasks_io_update
tools.description:
Update IO/checker payload. 'io' object usually contains 'input'/'output' format description strings.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "io": {"input": "stdin", "output": "stdout"}, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_checker_get
tools.description:
Retrieve checker metadata (checker_type, precision, custom code, etc.).
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42}

tools.name: tasks_checker_update
tools.description:
Update the checker definition. 'checker' object MUST contain 'checker_type'. For 'custom_checker', 'checker' (source code) and 'checker_language' are required.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "checker": {"checker_type": "custom_checker", "checker": "// code", "checker_language": "cpp:20-clang13"}, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_testsets_list
tools.description:
List testsets for a task with pagination.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "page": 1, "page_size": 10}

tools.name: tasks_testsets_get
tools.description:
Retrieve a single testset.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "testset_id": 7}

tools.name: tasks_testsets_create
tools.description:
Create a new testset at an optional index.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "index": 0, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_testsets_update
tools.description:
Update metadata for a testset (index, score, metadata, etc.).
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "testset_id": 7, "update": {"index": 1, "score": 10}, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_testsets_delete
tools.description:
Delete a testset.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "testset_id": 7, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_testsets_upload_zip
tools.description:
Upload a ZIP archive of tests. 'zip' can be base64 data URI, bytes, or file path. Set 'stream': true for large files.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "testset_id": 7, "zip": "data:application/zip;base64,...", "stream": true, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_tests_get
tools.description:
Fetch a single test case by index.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "testset_id": 7, "index": 0}

tools.name: tasks_tests_upload_single
tools.description:
Upload a single test case. 'input_data' and 'answer_data' can be base64 data URIs, bytes, or file paths.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "testset_id": 7, "input_data": "input...", "answer_data": "output...", "position": -1, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_tests_delete_one
tools.description:
Delete a single test case.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "testset_id": 7, "index": 0, "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_tests_delete_many
tools.description:
Delete multiple test cases by indexes.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "testset_id": 7, "indexes": [0, 1], "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_examples_get
tools.description:
Retrieve a task's example IO pairs.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42}

tools.name: tasks_examples_set
tools.description:
Replace task example IO sets. PASSED AS LISTS of strings.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "inputs": ["1 2", "3 4"], "outputs": ["3", "7"], "confirm": true}

tools.name: tasks_examples_add
tools.description:
Append a single example input/output pair.
Example args: {"hub": "awesome-hub", "task_id": 42, "input": "1 2", "output": "3", "confirm": true}
